metadata.title: FlowDesk · Software access requests
metadata.description: Request, approve and track software access in one clear workflow. Explore the FlowDesk demo.

welcome.eyebrow: Software access, with a clear process
welcome.title:
Every request.

welcome.description: Move software access requests out of scattered messages and into one shared workflow. Employees request, approvers decide, and IT records the work.

welcome.footer: One workflow. Three perspectives. Full traceability.
